```{r}
## CellChat analysis
setwd("/project/uvm_mckay/shamima.akter/stereo_liver/data")
getwd()
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
#library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(harmony)
library(HDF5Array)
##the best working 
library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
#seurat_obj<-readRDS("seurat_obj_with_celltypeB03022E1_4815Liver_150_10genefilteredParam30res0.55seurat.rds")## perform exact same analysis with this data too
seurat_obj <- readRDS("seurat_obj_with_celltype4826-9600genes_200_15filtereparam55dres0.42seurat.rds")
# 1. Ensure your active identity is set to your cell type annotations
Idents(seurat_obj) <- "predicted_cell_type" # Change to your actual metadata column name

# 2. Set the spatial scale factors (CRITICAL FOR STEREO-SEQ BIN50)
spatial.factors <- data.frame(
  ratio = 25,       # 1 Bin50 = 25 µm
  tol = 12.5,       # Tolerance threshold (half a bin)
  row.names = "StereoSeq" 
)
#head(rownames(seurat_obj_filtered))
# 3. Create the CellChat object
cellchat <- createCellChat(
  object = seurat_obj,
  group.by = "predicted_cell_type",
  assay = "RNA",
  #datatype = "spatial",
  coordinates = seurat_obj@meta.data[, c("x", "y")], # Ensure these match your spatial coordinate column names
  spatial.factors = spatial.factors
)
# 1. Load the database
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human 
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB

# 2. Subset to expressed genes to save memory
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)

# 3. Identify over-expressed genes and interactions
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
# 1. Compute probabilities
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(
  cellchat,
  type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1,
  distance.use = TRUE,         
  contact.knn.k = 8,           # Assumes each bin touches 8 neighbors
  scale.distance = 0.01        
)

# 2. Filter out noisy interactions (involving fewer than 10 cells)
#cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)

# 3. Compute pathways and aggregate the entire network
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)

# 1. Calculate network centrality (required for plotting)
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")

# 2. Generate the Circle Plot
# The 'weight.scale = TRUE' makes the line thickness proportional to interaction strength.
# The 'vertex.weight' makes the circle size proportional to the number of cells in that group.
#groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))

pathways <- cellchat@netP$pathways
print(pathways)


groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents)) # Get cell counts for node size
names(groupSize) <- levels(cellchat@idents)

netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, 
                 vertex.weight = groupSize, 
                 weight.scale = TRUE, 
                 label.edge = FALSE,, 
                 title.name = "Number of interactions")

# Plot ONLY the interactions originating from or targeting Cholangiocytes
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, 
                 vertex.weight = groupSize, 
                 weight.scale = TRUE, 
                 label.edge = FALSE, 
                 sources.use = "Cholangiocytes", # The cell sending the signal
                 targets.use = "Cholangiocytes", # The cell receiving the signal
                 title.name = "Cholangiocyte Interaction Network")
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, 
                 vertex.weight = groupSize, 
                 weight.scale = TRUE, 
                 label.edge = FALSE, 
                 sources.use = "Hepatocytes", # The cell sending the signal
                 targets.use = "Hepatocytes", # The cell receiving the signal
                 title.name = "Hepatocytes Interaction Network")

netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = groupSize,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Number of interactions"
)
cellchat@idents

table(cellchat@idents)
#graphics.off()
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
names(groupSize) <- levels(cellchat@idents)
netVisual_circle(
  cellchat@net$count,
  vertex.weight = groupSize,
  weight.scale = TRUE,
  label.edge = FALSE,
  title.name = "Number of interactions"
)

```

```{r}
##Hotspot Workflow
############################################################
# Hotspot workflow for Stereo-seq liver Seurat object
# Runs from RStudio using reticulate + Python hotspot
## Outputs:
# 1) module heatmap
# 2) module-by-celltype heatmap
# 3) spatial maps for top modules
# 4) module gene-network plots
# 5) GO enrichment table per module
############################################################
##
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
#.libPaths("/project/uvm_mckay/shamima.akter/stereo_liver/R/RStudio-x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.4")
setwd("/project/uvm_mckay/shamima.akter/stereo_liver/data")
getwd()
library(zellkonverter)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
#library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(harmony)
library(HDF5Array)
library(reticulate)
library(anndata)
############################
# 1. USER SETTINGS
############################
seurat_rds   <- "seurat_obj_with_celltypeB03022E1_4815Liver_150_10genefilteredParam30res0.55seurat.rds"
assay_use    <- "RNA"              # use normalized/raw RNA assay, not integrated
slot_use     <- "counts"           # raw counts for Hotspot
celltype_col <- "predicted_cell_type"        # metadata column with cell types
x_col        <- "x"                # metadata x coordinate
y_col        <- "y"                # metadata y coordinate

# Hotspot parameters
n_neighbors       <- 30
hotspot_model     <- "danb"
autocorr_fdr      <- 0.05
min_gene_threshold <- 20
core_only         <- TRUE

# plotting
top_n_modules_to_map <- 16
top_n_modules_network <- 3
top_terms_per_module <- 8
outdir_4815 <- "hotspot2_results_4815"
dir.create(outdir_4815, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

############################
# 2. LOAD SEURAT OBJECT
############################
seu <- readRDS(seurat_rds)

if (!(assay_use %in% Assays(seu))) {
  stop("Assay not found: ", assay_use)
}
DefaultAssay(seu) <- assay_use

required_cols <- c(celltype_col, x_col, y_col)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(seu@meta.data))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

# clean metadata
meta <- seu@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    .cell = colnames(seu),
    .celltype = trimws(as.character(.data[[celltype_col]])),
    .x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", trimws(as.character(.data[[x_col]]))))),
    .y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", trimws(as.character(.data[[y_col]])))))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(.cell, .celltype, .x, .y)

keep <- is.finite(meta$.x) & is.finite(meta$.y) & !is.na(meta$.celltype) & meta$.celltype != ""
meta <- meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
seu  <- subset(seu, cells = meta$.cell)

Idents(seu) <- factor(meta$.celltype)

# counts matrix: genes x cells
counts <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay_use, slot = slot_use)
counts <- counts[, meta$.cell, drop = FALSE]

# remove genes with all-zero counts
gene_keep <- Matrix::rowSums(counts) > 0
counts <- counts[gene_keep, , drop = FALSE]

message("Cells kept: ", ncol(counts))
message("Genes kept: ", nrow(counts))
#library(reticulate)
############################
# 3. SET UP PYTHON / HOTSPOT
############################
# Create/use your existing Python env manually if preferred:
#use_condaenv("hotspot_env", required = TRUE)

# Example setup commands to run ONCE in R if needed:
#reticulate::conda_create("hotspot_env", packages = "python=3.10")
#reticulate::conda_install("hotspot_env",
#packages = c("pip", "numpy", "pandas", "scipy", "anndata"),
#pip = FALSE
#)
##other way to get hotspotenv
# reticulate::py_install("hotspotsc", envname = "hotspot_env", pip = TRUE)
############################
##Then restart R

# declare Python packages before import()
py_require(c(
  "hotspotsc",
  "anndata",
  "numpy",
  "pandas",
  "scipy"
))
library(reticulate)
# optional: see what reticulate plans to use
py_config()

# now import ## Neeed to get all these libraries below for the analysis
hotspot <- import("hotspot")
anndata <- import("anndata")
np <- import("numpy")
pd <- import("pandas")
scipy_sparse <- import("scipy.sparse")

############################
############################
# 4. BUILD ANNData FOR HOTSPOT
############################
# Hotspot v1+ expects AnnData and can use spatial coordinates
# as the metric via latent_obsm_key. Counts should be cells x genes.
# We keep raw counts in adata.layers['counts'] and store total counts in obs.
# Documented workflow: create object, create_knn_graph, compute_autocorrelations,
# compute_local_correlations, create_modules, calculate_module_scores.
# counts matrix from Seurat: genes x cells
expr_mat <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay_use, slot = "counts")

# subset to cells kept in metadata
expr_mat <- expr_mat[, meta$.cell, drop = FALSE]

# remove zero-count genes
expr_mat <- expr_mat[Matrix::rowSums(expr_mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

message("Expression matrix class: ", class(expr_mat))
message("Expression matrix dim: ", paste(dim(expr_mat), collapse = " x "))

# convert to dense then transpose for AnnData / Hotspot
expr_dense <- as.matrix(expr_mat)
expr_t <- t(expr_dense)   # now cells x genes

# scipy sparse matrix
counts_csr <- scipy_sparse$csr_matrix(expr_t)
#counts_csr <- scipy_sparse$csr_matrix(t(as.matrix(counts)))  # cells x genes

# create AnnData
adata <- anndata$AnnData(X = counts_csr)
adata$obs_names <- as.list(colnames(expr_mat))
adata$var_names <- as.list(rownames(expr_mat))

# raw counts layer
adata$layers["counts"] <- counts_csr
adata <- anndata$AnnData(X = counts_csr)
#adata$obs_names <- as.list(colnames(counts))
#adata$var_names <- as.list(rownames(counts))
adata$obs_names <- as.list(colnames(expr_mat))
adata$var_names <- as.list(rownames(expr_mat))

# add raw counts layer explicitly
adata$layers["counts"] <- counts_csr
celltype = as.character(meta$.predicted_cell_type)
# obs metadata
obs_df <- pd$DataFrame(
  dict(
    total_counts = as.numeric(Matrix::colSums(expr_mat)),
    celltype = as.character(meta$.celltype)
  ),
  index = as.list(colnames(expr_mat))
)
adata$obs <- obs_df
adata$obs <- obs_df

# spatial coordinates in obsm
coords_mat <- as.matrix(meta[, c(".x", ".y")])
storage.mode(coords_mat) <- "double"
adata$obsm["spatial"] <- coords_mat

############################
# 5. RUN HOTSPOT
############################
hs <- hotspot$Hotspot(
  adata,
  layer_key = "counts",
  model = hotspot_model,
  latent_obsm_key = "spatial",
  umi_counts_obs_key = "total_counts"
)

hs$create_knn_graph(
  weighted_graph = FALSE,
  n_neighbors = as.integer(n_neighbors)
)

# gene autocorrelations
hs_results_py <- hs$compute_autocorrelations()
hs_results <- py_to_r(hs_results_py)
hs_results$gene <- rownames(hs_results)

write.csv(hs_results,
          file.path(outdir_4815, "hotspot_gene_autocorrelations_liver4815.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

sig_genes <- hs_results %>%
  filter(FDR < autocorr_fdr) %>%
  arrange(FDR) %>%
  pull(gene)

message("Significant Hotspot genes: ", length(sig_genes))

if (length(sig_genes) < min_gene_threshold) {
  stop("Too few significant genes for module detection. Try relaxing autocorr_fdr.")
}

# local correlations
lcz_py <- hs$compute_local_correlations(sig_genes)
lcz <- py_to_r(lcz_py)

# create modules
mods_py <- hs$create_modules(
  min_gene_threshold = as.integer(min_gene_threshold),
  core_only = core_only,
  fdr_threshold = autocorr_fdr
)
modules <- py_to_r(mods_py)
modules <- data.frame(
  gene = names(modules),
  module = as.integer(modules),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# remove unassigned genes (-1)
modules_use <- modules %>% filter(module >= 0)

write.csv(modules,
          file.path(outdir_4815, "hotspot_modules_4815.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# module scores: cells x modules
module_scores_py <- hs$calculate_module_scores()
module_scores <- py_to_r(module_scores_py)
module_scores <- as.data.frame(module_scores)
module_scores$.cell <- rownames(module_scores)

# clean module column names
colnames(module_scores) <- gsub("^X", "M", colnames(module_scores))
if (!".cell" %in% colnames(module_scores)) colnames(module_scores)[ncol(module_scores)] <- ".cell"

write.csv(module_scores,
          file.path(outdir_4815, "hotspot_module_scores_4815.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

############################
# 6. ADD MODULE SCORES TO SEURAT
############################
score_cols <- setdiff(colnames(module_scores), ".cell")
#score_mat <- module_scores %>%
  #tibble::column_to_rownames(".cell") %>%
  #as.matrix()
module_scores <- as.data.frame(module_scores)
rownames(module_scores) <- NULL

score_mat <- module_scores %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(".cell") %>%
  as.matrix()


# ensure cells align
score_mat <- score_mat[colnames(seu), , drop = FALSE]
seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = as.data.frame(score_mat))

############################
# 7. PANEL A: MODULE HEATMAP + GO TERMS
############################
# select genes ordered by module and z-score
modules_ordered <- modules_use %>%
  left_join(hs_results %>% dplyr::select(gene, Z), by = "gene") %>%
  arrange(module, desc(Z))

genes_heat <- modules_ordered$gene
expr_heat <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay_use, slot = "data")[genes_heat, , drop = FALSE]
expr_heat <- as.matrix(expr_heat)

# z-score by gene
expr_heat_z <- t(scale(t(expr_heat)))
expr_heat_z[is.na(expr_heat_z)] <- 0

# optionally subsample cells for plotting
set.seed(1)
max_cells_heat <- min(3000, ncol(expr_heat_z))
cells_heat <- sample(colnames(expr_heat_z), max_cells_heat)
expr_heat_z <- expr_heat_z[, cells_heat, drop = FALSE]

row_split <- factor(modules_ordered$module, levels = sort(unique(modules_ordered$module)))
module_colors <- structure(
  colorRampPalette(c("#3b4cc0", "#1fa187", "#fde725", "#d7191c"))(length(unique(row_split))),
  names = sort(unique(row_split))
)

#pdf(file.path(outdir, "PanelA_module_heatmap.pdf"), width = 12, height = 10)
ht <- Heatmap(
  expr_heat_z,
  name = "Z-scores",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_split = row_split,
  row_title = NULL,
  col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#3b4cc0", "white", "#b40426"))
)
draw(ht)

#dev.off()

ggsave(filename = file.path(outdir_4815,"PanelA_module_heatmap_4815.png"),
       ht,
       width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 600)


############################
# 8. GO ENRICHMENT PER MODULE
############################
go_list <- list()

for (m in sort(unique(modules_use$module))) {
  genes_m <- modules_use %>% filter(module == m) %>% pull(gene)
  
  # map SYMBOL -> ENTREZID for cattle
  gene_map <- suppressMessages(
    bitr(genes_m,
         fromType = "SYMBOL",
         toType = "ENTREZID",
         OrgDb = org.Bt.eg.db)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(gene_map) && nrow(gene_map) > 0) {
    ego <- suppressMessages(
      enrichGO(
        gene          = unique(gene_map$ENTREZID),
        OrgDb         = org.Bt.eg.db,
        ont           = "BP",
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        readable      = TRUE
      )
    )
    
    if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
      ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego) %>%
        mutate(module = paste0("M", m))
      go_list[[paste0("M", m)]] <- ego_df
    }
  }
}

go_df <- bind_rows(go_list)
write.csv(go_df, file.path(outdir_4815, "module_GO_enrichment_4815.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# optional GO text summary for plotting/inspection
go_top <- go_df %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_terms_per_module) %>%
  ungroup()
write.csv(go_top, file.path(outdir_4815, "module_GO_top_terms_4815.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
##these data can be used to generate other results based in specific interests
```

```{r}

## Moniocle3Analysis : pseudotime calculation for PV to CV in liver stereo-seq data
setwd("/project/uvm_mckay/shamima.akter/stereo_liver/data")
getwd()
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(monocle3)
#library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)

# =========================
# 1. Load Seurat object
# =========================

##seurat_obj <- readRDS("seurat_obj_with_celltypeB03022E1_4815Liver_150_10genefilteredParam30res0.55seurat.rds")
seurat_obj <- readRDS("seurat_obj_with_celltype4826-9600genes_200_15filtereparam55dres0.42seurat.rds")
#seurat_obj_with_celltype4826-9600genes_200_15filtereparam55dres0.42seurat.rds
# Check metadata column
table(seurat_obj$predicted_cell_type)

# =========================
# 2. Subset hepatocytes only
# =========================

hep_sub <- subset(
  seurat_obj,
  subset = predicted_cell_type == "Hepatocytes"
)

# Check number of hepatocytes
dim(hep_sub)
table(hep_sub$predicted_cell_type)

# =========================
# 3. Standard Seurat processing
# =========================

DefaultAssay(hep_sub) <- "RNA"

hep_sub <- NormalizeData(hep_sub)

hep_sub <- FindVariableFeatures(
  hep_sub,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 3000
)

hep_sub <- ScaleData(hep_sub)
hep_sub <- RunPCA(hep_sub, npcs = 30)

# Use dims based on elbow plot; usually 1:15 or 1:20
ElbowPlot(hep_sub)

hep_sub <- RunUMAP(
  hep_sub,
  dims = 1:15,
  n.neighbors = 30,
  min.dist = 0.3
)

# =========================
# 4. Define PV and CV marker genes
# =========================

pv_genes <- c("PCK1", "ASS1", "CPS1", "HAMP")
cv_genes <- c("CYP2E1", "GLUL", "CYP1A2", "SLC10A1")

# Keep only genes present in object
pv_genes <- intersect(pv_genes, rownames(hep_sub))
cv_genes <- intersect(cv_genes, rownames(hep_sub))

pv_genes
cv_genes

# Stop if too few markers found
if (length(pv_genes) < 2) stop("Too few PV genes found in object.")
if (length(cv_genes) < 2) stop("Too few CV genes found in object.")

# =========================
# 5. Add PV/CV module scores
# =========================

hep_sub <- AddModuleScore(
  hep_sub,
  features = list(pv_genes),
  name = "PV_Score"
)

hep_sub <- AddModuleScore(
  hep_sub,
  features = list(cv_genes),
  name = "CV_Score"
)

# Higher = more PV-like
hep_sub$zonation_score <- hep_sub$PV_Score1 - hep_sub$CV_Score1

# =========================
# 6. Assign three broad zones
# =========================

hep_sub$Zone <- cut(
  hep_sub$zonation_score,
  breaks = quantile(
    hep_sub$zonation_score,
    probs = c(0, 0.33, 0.66, 1),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  labels = c("CV_Hepatocytes", "Midzone", "PV_Hepatocytes"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

#Plot hepatocyte zones before Monocle

##This checks whether your PV/CV/Midzone assignment looks reasonable.

#library(Seurat)
#library(ggplot2)

hep_sub$Zone <- factor(
  hep_sub$Zone,
  levels = c("PV_Hepatocytes", "Midzone", "CV_Hepatocytes")
)

table(hep_sub$Zone)
library(ggplot2)
p_zone <- DimPlot(
  hep_sub,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "Zone",
  pt.size = 0.8,
  shuffle = TRUE,
  raster = FALSE
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "PV_Hepatocytes" = "#1B9E77",  # green
      "Midzone" = "#7570B3",         # purple/blue
      "CV_Hepatocytes" = "#D95F02"   # orange/red
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hepatocyte zonation clusters",
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.1, color = "black")
  )

p_zone
```

```{r}
cds <- as.cell_data_set(hep_sub)

# Transfer UMAP coordinates from Seurat to Monocle
reducedDims(cds)$UMAP <- Embeddings(hep_sub, "umap")

# Make sure Zone exists in cds
colData(cds)$Zone <- hep_sub$Zone

##Run Monocle3 trajectory
cds <- cluster_cells(
  cds,
  reduction_method = "UMAP"
)

cds <- learn_graph(
  cds,
  use_partition = TRUE
)
##Correct root node selection using PV hepatocytes
get_earliest_principal_node <- function(cds, column_name, cluster_name) {
  
  cell_ids <- which(colData(cds)[, column_name] == cluster_name)
  
  if (length(cell_ids) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No cells found for", cluster_name))
  }
  
  closest_vertex <- cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex
  closest_vertex <- as.matrix(closest_vertex[colnames(cds), ])
  
  root_pr_nodes <- igraph::V(principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]])$name[
    as.numeric(names(which.max(table(closest_vertex[cell_ids, ]))))
  ]
  
  return(root_pr_nodes)
}

root_node <- get_earliest_principal_node(
  cds,
  column_name = "Zone",
  cluster_name = "PV_Hepatocytes"
)

root_node

cds <- order_cells(
  cds,
  root_pr_nodes = root_node
)
###Plot 1: PV–CV trajectory with zones
p_traj_zone <- plot_cells(
  cds,
  color_cells_by = "Zone",
  label_cell_groups = FALSE,
  label_leaves = FALSE,
  label_branch_points = FALSE,
  label_roots = TRUE,
  cell_size = 0.8,
  graph_label_size = 3
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Liver zone",
    values = c(
      "PV_Hepatocytes" = "#1B9E77",
      "Midzone" = "#7570B3",
      "CV_Hepatocytes" = "#D95F02"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hepatocyte zones with PV trajectory origin",
    x = "UMAP 1",
    y = "UMAP 2"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    
  )


p_traj_zone
```
